project_type: ASP.NET Core (.NET 9) distributed system: three DDD bounded contexts (Ordering, Inventory, Payment) each layered Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api, a shared Contracts message library, and (to be created) a dedicated OrderProcess.Saga worker/web host. MassTransit over RabbitMQ for messaging, EF Core 9 over PostgreSQL for persistence.
build_system: dotnet SDK 9.0.310, single solution d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\OrderProcess.sln. QUIRK: package versions are currently INCONSISTENT and must be centralized via a new Directory.Packages.props. MassTransit is 8.5.11 in Inventory.Api but 9.2.3 in Ordering.Api and Payment.Api; the spec FIXES MassTransit at 8.5.11, so all projects must be pinned to 8.5.11. EF Core drifts 9.0.5 vs 9.0.8 -> unify to 9.0.8; Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 9.0.4; Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi 9.0.12. After adding Directory.Packages.props, strip the Version= attribute from every PackageReference in all csproj.
test_framework: None. Spec forbids adding tests unless explicitly requested. Verification is manual per each feature's Verify steps (build + ef migrations + docker compose + HTTP calls + DB queries).
test_command: No automated tests. Primary gate: dotnet build OrderProcess.sln succeeds with 0 errors. EF: dotnet ef migrations add / database update. Runtime: docker compose up -d then dotnet run the hosts and exercise HTTP endpoints.
verification_instructions: 1) dotnet build OrderProcess.sln -> 0 errors (baseline already green). 2) docker compose up -d brings up postgres:16 + rabbitmq:3-management; mgmt UI http://localhost:15672 (guest/guest); four DBs orderingdb/inventorydb/paymentdb/sagadb exist. 3) For EF changes run `dotnet ef migrations add <Name> --project <Infra.csproj> --startup-project <Api.csproj>` then `dotnet ef database update` with the same project pair; saga DbContext is self-hosted in OrderProcess.Saga so both --project and --startup-project point at OrderProcess.Saga.csproj. 4) Happy path: seed stock, POST /orders, POST /orders/{id}/submit with amount below the payment fail threshold -> order Confirmed, stock decremented, Payment Completed, saga finalized. 5) Compensation: same with amount at/above threshold (or ForceFail) -> ReleaseStock fires, stock restored, order Cancelled, saga finalized. 6) Outbox durability: stop rabbitmq, do a business op, confirm OutboxMessage row pending in the context DB, start rabbitmq, confirm it drains. Hosts must NOT be started blocking (run in background / separate windows) on Windows PowerShell; chain commands with ';' not '&&'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: EF migrations are generated code committed into each *.Infrastructure/Migrations folder (and the saga host's Migrations folder): the *_<Name>.cs, *_<Name>.Designer.cs, and <Context>ModelSnapshot.cs. Produce them with `dotnet ef migrations add`. No other generated-then-checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell: chain with ';' (NOT '&&'); do not start long-running hosts in a blocking foreground call (use background jobs / separate windows and stop them after verifying). dotnet 9.0.310, dotnet ef 9.0.5 (resolved via the Infrastructure Tools PackageReference), Docker 29.x all confirmed present. Postgres creds postgres/postgres (match existing connection strings); RabbitMQ guest/guest. NO git worktree - work directly in d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess. Do NOT commit unless strictly necessary. New explanatory comments in ARABIC to match existing style; identifiers stay English.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering files exist in the repo. Governing spec is docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT.md: orchestration (not choreography) via a single OrderSaga; dedicated saga host with its OWN postgres database (sagadb); at-least-once delivery with idempotent (Inbox) consumers; every DB-coupled publish goes through the MassTransit EntityFrameworkCore Outbox (AddEntityFrameworkOutbox + UsePostgres + UseBusOutbox). Keep bounded contexts isolated: no project may reference another context's Domain/Infrastructure; cross-context comms ONLY via Contracts messages over the bus. Pin exact package versions (central management). No secrets in source (env vars / appsettings). Parameterized EF only.
key_patterns: Each context: Api (minimal API Program.cs + optional Consumers/) -> Application (handlers + Abstractions repo interfaces + Commands) -> Infrastructure (DbContext in Context/, repositories in Repositories/, EF migrations in Migrations/) -> Domain (rich aggregates raising internal IDomainEvent). DbContexts ctor-inject DbContextOptions and configure entities in OnModelCreating with builder.Ignore(x => x.DomainEvents). Repositories wrap DbSet add/get + a SaveChangesAsync passthrough. NAME CLASH: domain events (Inventory.Domain.Events.StockReserved, Payment.Domain.Events.PaymentCompleted/PaymentFailed) share names with Contracts integration events; new publish/consume code MUST use the Contracts.* types explicitly (alias if needed). Contracts already carry CorrelationId on StockReserved/StockReservationFailed/StockReleased/PaymentCompleted/PaymentFailed/ReserveStock/ReleaseStock/ProcessPayment; only ConfirmOrder (command) and an integration OrderSubmitted event are missing. Order aggregate already has Submit()/Confirm()/Cancel(); OrderStatus enum = {Draft,Submitted,Confirmed,Cancelled} (NO Rejected). Payment entity has Process(bool forceFail) (else 90% random success).
directory_structure: Repo root d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess has OrderProcess.sln, docs/ (IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT.md), src/, .github/ (empty of workflows). src/ holds Contracts/ (Commands/Commands.cs, Events/Events.cs) and three context roots: src/ordering/ (lowercase on disk) with Ordering.Domain|Application|Infrastructure|Api; src/Inventory/ with Inventory.*; src/Payment/ with Payment.*. Each Api is Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web with a minimal-API Program.cs. Each Infrastructure has Context/<Name>DbContext.cs, Repositories/, Migrations/. The saga host to be created at src/Saga/OrderProcess.Saga/. Plan + FEAT artifacts live under .agents/tasks/saga-ddd-phase0-2/ (OUTSIDE src, never committed).
